product.title: Ruby's Horseback Adventures Utah Thunder Mt. 4 Hour Ride

description.text: In Bryce Canyon National Park, Get away from the park crowds on this epic four-hour tour on horseback. With the Bryce Canyon area as your backdrop, you’ll clip-clop along Old West trails used by both cowboys and Indigenous groups, climbing up and down the scenic Red Canyon. Stops include Red Canyon, Thunder Mountain. Appropriate for beginners to experts, this ride truly goes off the beaten path for serious canyon adventure. Ideal for visitors basing near Bryce Canyon City who want a guided red-rock experience without coordinating park entrances, trailheads, or photo stops on their own.
